date.as_written: saṃvat 820 mārggaśīra māse śukle pakṣe dvitīyāyāṃ tithau, jyeṣṭha para mūla nakṣētre dhṛtiyoge yathā karaṇa muhurtte, somavāsare

notes: Catalogue records date as 'NS 820 māgha', but the colophon text clearly reads 'mārggaśīra māse'. 'lohodevara' refers to a stone temple (lohōṃ devala) in front of the Pāladhvākhā gate in Bhaktapur, where a koṭyāhuti yajña was held on the day of completion.
